# KAvach Cricket Club

> Bangalore's premier leather-ball cricket club exclusively designed for working professionals, adults, and seniors. Headquartered at Play Arena, Sarjapur Road, the club features daily morning practice nets, competitive weekend matches, and flagship tournaments like the KAvach Premier League (KPL).

## Core Information
- [Home](https://www.kavachcricket.com/) - Main landing page, player pathways, and club overview.
- [About KAvach](https://www.kavachcricket.com/about.html) - Our history, 6 defining pillars, and official in-house franchise teams.
- [Policies & Code of Conduct](https://www.kavachcricket.com/policies.html) - Mandatory safety gear, strict no-refund policy, liability waivers, and disciplinary rules.

## Programs & Tournaments
- [KAvach Premier League (KPL)](https://www.kavachcricket.com/kpl.html) - Our flagship IPL-style amateur tournament featuring live auction drafts and bespoke colored kits.
- [KAvach Timeout](https://www.kavachcricket.com/timeout.html) - Our signature annual family sports evening including mini cricket, tug of war, and a family banquet.
